nom: Filorga Time-Filler Essence Anti-Aging Facial Lotion for Smoother Radiant Skin Collagen-Boosting Formula for 24 Hour Hydration and Radiance (5.07 fl oz)

avis.titre: Great for sensitive skin; terrific product.Great for sensitive skin; terrific product.
avis.texte: This is a review of the Filorga Time-Filler Anti-Aging Facial Lotion. I really have had good luck with Filorga products in the past so I was eager to get this. I am happy to say I really like it. This comes well-packaged and secured. I have attached some photos so you can see what it looks like. Now I have older, dry and sensitive skin so I am always cautious when trying out new skin products. This one is terrific. I am not sure I would call this a lotion since the texture is more like a toner, but my skin seems to drink this up and stay smooth and hydrated for along time afterwards. I sometimes use this twice a day, or whenever my face is clean and toned. This does have a scent to it which is often is a problem for me, but this scent is lovely and light and I have had no irrational or redness. My skin loves this. Recommended. .

I’ve been using the Filorga Time-Filler Essence for about a month now, and I’m genuinely impressed with how it’s transformed my skincare routine. This essence is a lightweight, watery lotion that absorbs quickly, leaving my skin feeling instantly hydrated and prepped for the rest of my regimen. The formula is packed with skin-loving ingredients like NCEF, hyaluronic acid, and glycerin, which work together to provide 24-hour hydration and reinforce the skin barrier. Additionally, the inclusion of gluconolactone acts as a gentle exfoliant, removing dead skin cells and promoting a smoother texture. What sets this essence apart is its use of a moth bean extract, a plant-based alternative to retinol, which helps stimulate collagen production and smooth fine lines without the irritation often associated with traditional retinoids. After consistent use, I’ve noticed a visible improvement in my skin’s texture and tone. It feels smoother, looks more radiant, and appears firmer. While the anti-aging effects are subtle, they’re certainly noticeable over time. The essence also works well under serums and moisturizers, enhancing their effectiveness. Overall, the Filorga Time-Filler Essence has become a staple in my skincare routine. Its hydrating and anti-aging benefits make it a worthwhile investment for anyone looking to improve their skin's appearance and health.

The Filorga Time-Filler Essence feels incredibly lightweight upon application, yet it still delivers an amazing level of hydration that truly lasts throughout the entire day, keeping my skin feeling supple and comfortable. I've noticed my complexion looking significantly smoother, with a refined texture, and much more radiant. It absorbs quickly into the skin, making it a perfect and effortless first step in my morning and evening routines. It doesn't leave any sticky or heavy residue behind, allowing other products to layer beautifully.

avis.titre: Nice toner, not really lotionNice toner, not really lotion
avis.texte: The Filorga Time-Filler Essence Anti-Aging Facial Lotion for Smoother Radiant Skin Collagen-Boosting Formula for 24 Hour Hydration and Radiance (5.07 fl oz) is. A nice toner or serum, but I wouldn't call it a lotion. It absorbs quickly and feels good on. It has a floral scent that's stronger than I'm used to. Overall, it's a nice facial moisturizer.

Filorga Time-Filler Essence Anti-Aging Facial Lotion is the best toner/serum I've ever used. Really. At age 60 I've tried a lot of products too. From the second you apply this to your skin you'll sigh with relief. It's a combination of the light airy scent, hydrating feel, almost weightless application and the immediate results. My skin instantly feels plumper and looks smoother. After the toner dries I continue on with the serums and moisturizer. This wonderful skincare product is from France and also contains collagen to help plump up that mature skin. Everything in this lotion style toner seems to coalesce into a single perfect addition to my facial routine. Makes the perfect base after cleansing both am and pm. It is worth the cost to me and I'll buy another bottle when this is done. Recommended.

This is a good hydrating base after cleansing. I have dry skin and applying this before serum and moisturizer gives me an extra dose of hydration. If I am in a hurry, or the weather is warm and humid, I find this essence to give enough hydration, without having to apply moisturizer. It feels soft, blends in well, and doesn’t leave a sticky feeling.

avis.titre: More essence than a lotion with its very watery consistency
avis.texte: This Filorga essence is very watery like a lotion, it does not even have the texture to be called a serum so take note before you dose this out on your hands. There is added fragrance which is distinctly floral but it is mild enough that it won't overpower but clearly present so if you are sensitive to scents this might be too strong for you. Since this has such a watery texture, it is hard to know if you feel any significant changes in your skin. It does dry and absorb fast enough and does not leave a tacky feel on the skin. This will layer well as it dries quick and does not cause pilling in your next step of skincare. The box states that this helps reveal the skin's radiance and prepares for the following products. I did find that it did not interfere with other serums but I also do not know that it helped my skin appear more radiant. There was no dewy or glowing look but I don't mind that as this is not the last step in skincare. The product did not irritate, interfere with other serums, and absorbs quickly. No rash or redness on my skin.

The Filorga Time-Filler Essence has completely transformed my skincare routine. This anti-aging facial lotion is a powerhouse of hydration and radiance, delivering 24-hour moisture that leaves my skin looking smoother and more youthful. The collagen-boosting formula works wonders, visibly reducing fine lines and giving my face a fresh, glowing appearance. After just a few days of use, my skin felt softer, looked brighter, and had a noticeable improvement in texture. The lightweight formula absorbs quickly and doesn’t leave any greasy residue, making it perfect for both day and night application. If you're looking for a product that delivers lasting hydration, radiance, and an anti-aging boost, this is definitely a must-try. Highly recommend for anyone wanting to maintain a youthful, radiant complexion!

This lotion is very lightweight and applies evenly. I noticed the creamy yet sheer quality of the lotion the minute I put some on my hand. I applied it in the morning after I had cleaned my face and used my moisturizer, and noticed its immediate absorption. I tend to have sensitive skin and didn't experience any type of reaction after use. This French-sourced skincare leaves no noticeable residue or stickiness after application. It has a very light floral scent that was not overwhelming or lingering. I applied my foundation on top of it, and it looked great all day!

My skin absorbs this really well. This makes my skin very moisturized and soft to the touch. This is not a typical lotion consistency, it’s more so like a toner. This has the faintest scent to it, nothing heavy. I do really like this. This would be great if you’re looking for something other than a lotion.
